evidence.decision: Chooses a real proximity benefit and combines task context with available distance/direction, refusing to invent a confident bearing when only distance survives.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a capability/signal-state feedback map and corrected proximity artifact, including permission, degraded sensing and a finishable nonsensing alternative.
evidence.transformation: The museum finder replaces a stale left arrow and UWB-blocked lookup with distance plus direction-unavailable guidance, restored valid bearings and independent search/list access.
evidence.verification: Checks distance-only arrows, frozen misleading feedback, Watch background assumptions and incomplete alternatives; mock data is correctly limited to state handling rather than sensor accuracy.
evidence.applicability: Requires compatible hardware, recognizes session-scoped identifiers, excludes macOS/tvOS/visionOS and preserves Watch distance-only foreground participation.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Privacy for in-use permission and Accessibility for attention-appropriate channels and alternative completion.
evidence.distinctiveness: Continuous approach feedback, sensor field loss, obstruction/holding guidance and the distinction between distance and direction are practical Nearby Interaction decisions.
